title: Aipa calls for stronger food reserves, closer energy cooperation

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Southeast Asian lawmakers are calling for stronger food reserves, expanded support for farmers and fisherfolk, and closer cooperation to protect the region’s energy supplies from global disruptions. These were among six economic resolutions adopted at the 47th Association of Southeast Asian Nations (Asean) Inter-Parliamentary Assembly (Aipa) General Assembly in Manila and reflected in the joint communiqué issued Friday under the presidency of House Speaker Faustino “Bojie” G. Dy III. To help countries respond to climate-related agricultural risks and supply disruptions, Aipa called for stronger national and regional food reserves, emergency food assistance, and wider adoption of climate-smart farming […]...
